question: Who was awarded the 2021 DST-ICTP-IMU Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians from developing countries for her outstanding work in affine algebraic geometry and commutative algebra?
solution:
The correct option is **__Neena Gupta.__ **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Professor Neena Gupta, a mathematician at the Indian Statistical Institute in Kolkata, received the **Ramanujan Prize for Young Mathematicians **on **February 22, 2022,** in a virtual ceremony.
 
• 
 
The world's largest mathematical problem is said to be the **Zariski Cancellation Issue**, a fundamental algebraic geometry problem.

 
 
• 
 
Other awards received by Professor Neena Gupta:-​

 
 
• 
 
The 2015 Ramanujan Prize from the Ramanujan Institute for Advanced Study in Mathematics.

 
 
• 
 
2014 Young Scientists Award of the Indian National Science Academy for her work on the Zariski cancellation problem

 
 
• 
 
The inaugural Professor A. K. Agarwal Award from the Indian Mathematical Society in 2015.

 
 
• 
 
The 2017 B. M. Birla Science Prize in Mathematics.

 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is given in the honor of **Srinivasa Ramanujan**, a pure mathematics genius who largely learned the subject on his own and made outstanding contributions to the study of elliptic functions, continuous fractions, infinite series, and number theory.
 
• ​Sponsored and funded by 
 
 
• **DST ( The Department of Science and Technology )** of the Government of India.
 
• ** IMU ( International Mathematical Union ).**
 
• **ICTP ( International Centre for Theoretical Physics )**
 
 
 
• Eminent mathematicians were chosen for the Committee after discussions between the ICTP, the IMU, and the DST. The award's name was changed to the "DST-ICTP-IMU Ramanujan Prize in 2021.
